dialogOption.texten: Help! My kitchen is on fire.
Help! My kitchen is on fire.
My toaster! And the fire's spreading!
The counter! I accidentally threw a cloth on the burner... And the fire spreads quickly!
{USE A DAMP TOWEL} I want you to stay calm. Carefully cover the fire with a damp towel.
{USE WATER} Try to put out the fire with water.
{USE AN EXTINGUISHER} Ok, do you have an extinguisher?
{PUT OUT THE FIRE}Ok, use it to put out the fire.

dialogOption.emotions: noise in the background, completely panicked, screaming
dialogOption.texten: . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . Oh my god! It blew up! The hood started to burn too! Help!
It didn't help! What should I do?!

dialogOption.emotions: pause, water flush sound, then scream
the same as toastbw but with pause-faucet sound-pause instead of a flush
small explosion sound, completely panicked, screaming
dialogOption.texten: . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . Aaah! It blew up! My skin! I got burned! Everything's on fire!
{I'LL SEND FIREFIGHTERS AND AMBULANCE} Get out of the kitchen, get out of the house ma'am and make sure everybody else is out with you. The ambulance will be there soon.
{I'LL SEND FIREFIGHTERS} Ok, get yourself and anyone else that's in the house out of the house now. The fire department will be there soon.

dialogOption.emotions: nervous, after ok - from distance, faucet sound, pause then normal again.
pause after wait, extinguisher sound, then relieved

dialogOption.texten: . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . Phew... It's gone, I guess... I panicked... Thank you!
No problem. Just doing my job.

reportElement.texten: The operator gave the right instructions to the caller. Thanks to that, the situation was easily controlled and there was no need to dispatch the fire fighting team.
The operator failed to give the right instructions to the caller, which made the situation worse.
Due to the operator's wrong instructions, the caller got electrocuted and needed both firefighters' and paramedics' intervention.
The caller would've managed the situation by herself if the operator gave her the right instructions. The firefighters' intervention could've been avoided.
